notes: Live Activities: message send fix — ab message clock par nahi rukta; fail ho to Failed show hota hai aur Resend/Delete milta hai. Live Activities full screen khulti hai; members sirf wohi users jin ko access diya gaya hai. My Space khatam — saari cheezein Profile mein hain (oopar right wala profile button ya home se kholo). Profile photo ab oopar se crop nahi hoti, neeche saaf blur hai. Inactive employees ab lists mein nahi aate.
releaseNotes: Flashy v2.23: (1) Live Activities send fix — root cause: Telegram requests par koi timeout nahi tha; connection atak jaye to message hamesha ke liye clock par latak jata tha. Ab har request 25s par abort hoti hai, 3 koshishon ke baad post saaf 'Failed' ho jata hai (Resend/Delete ke saath), aur screen khuli ho to 20s par khud retry hota hai. App ke apne send function se live group mein text+photo bhej kar receipt (copyMessage) verify ki gayi, phir test messages delete. (2) Members: ab sirf woh ERP users jin ko User Control mein Live Activities access diya gaya hai — saare employees nahi. (3) INACTIVE employees ab Flashy/ERP ki tamam selection lists se ghayab (sirf Employee Directory mein dikhte hain). (4) My Space module khatam — Payslip, Attendance, Edit Profile, Advanced Options, saara kuch Profile screen mein (dono entry: header ka profile button aur home ki greeting card). (5) Live Activities full screen, edge-to-edge, apne back arrow ke saath. (6) Profile Hero: photo oopar se crop nahi, photo par chhota 'Profile' label, neeche white shine khatam — asal total blur. Verification: pure 26/26, timeout proof 25s abort, Chromium shell probe 29/29, desktop probe 6/6, live Telegram E2E 9/9, purane harnesses saare pass (consumption-finalize ke 3 purane reds is pack se ghair-mutaliq).
